Post-separation earnings power of the two standalone entities from the October 1 split — with the ~$100M dissynergy fear now largely retired ("we are saying it is closer to the $25 million range", 2026Q2) and the date hard-set ("we are targeting October 1 as the separation date"), the hinge moves to whether new Corteva (Crop Protection) can keep compounding EBITDA while Brazil price declines persist with no recovery expected in 2026 — first testable at the September 15 Investor Day 2029 frameworks.
